question:
**Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the given word.**

Threat
solution:
The correct answer is "Risk".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us understand the **meaning** of the given and the **marked words.**

 
 
• Threat means **an expression of intention to inflict evil, injury, or damage.**

 
 
• Synonyms: Danger or hazard or trouble.

 
 
• Example: *Global warming is a threat to the environment.*
 
 
 
 
 
• Risk means a possibility of loss or injury.
 
 
• Synonyms: Menace or peril or hazard.
 
 
• Example: *All investments have an element of risk.*
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• From the above explanation, it is clear that the word "risk" is the synonym of "threat".
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 4) Risk.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Let us understand the meaning of the other given words.
 
 
• Suggestion means giving an advice about what to do.
 
• **Proof** means evidence sufficient to establish a thing as true.
 
• Attention means the act of fixing a mind on something.
